name: g1-rc
description: Remote-control the Unitree G1 humanoid: a 3-service app group (motion API + camera stream + teleop web UI) that lets you drive the robot and watch its camera from a browser.

variables.name: RC_PORT
variables.description: Port for the teleop web UI — open http://<device>:<port> in a browser to drive the robot

variables.name: NETWORK_INTERFACE
variables.description: NIC on the deploy host that has the 192.168.123.0/24 address. On the G1's onboard computer this is normally 'eth0'.

variables.name: CAMERA_SOURCE
variables.description: Camera capture source: a V4L2 index or /dev/videoN path, an rtsp:// or http:// MJPEG URL, or a GStreamer pipeline ending in appsink. On the G1's RealSense D435i the colour node is typically 4.
